dateLabel: c. 2200 BCE (lasting most of the 22nd century BCE)
title: 4.2-kiloyear drought
place: Mesopotamia, Egypt, Indus and Yangtze regions
summary: A severe, long drought began around 2200 BCE. It may have helped bring down the Old Kingdom of Egypt, the Akkadian Empire and China's Liangzhu culture.
why: A warning from the past that climate shocks can topple whole states.
